SSDLite MobileNet v2, trained on COCO: finds people in a photo (js/faces.js uses its "person" boxes only).
From TensorFlow.js models, coco-ssd (https://github.com/tensorflow/tfjs-models/tree/master/coco-ssd), model files from
https://storage.googleapis.com/tfjs-models/savedmodel/ssdlite_mobilenet_v2/. Apache License 2.0.
